<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>TROGÜI TV Stick | Convierte tu TV en Smart TV</title>
<meta name="description" content="TV Stick Android 4K TROGÜI. Envío gratis a toda Colombia. Pago contra entrega.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700;9..144,800&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --clay:#E85D2A; --clay-dark:#C94A1C; --cream:#FBF5EC; --ink:#1F2A24;
    --sage:#4F7864; --sage-light:#DCE8E1; --gold:#E8B84B; --white:#FFFFFF; --line: rgba(31,42,36,0.12);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{margin:0; background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink); font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif; line-height:1.5;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  .wrap{max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}

  .topstrip{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.03em; text-align:center; padding:9px 12px;}
  .topstrip b{color:var(--gold);}

  header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50; background:var(--cream); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .headerbar{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:12px 24px; gap:12px;}
  .logo img{height:34px; width:auto; border-radius:6px;}
  .wa-btn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--sage); color:var(--white); padding:10px 16px; border-radius:100px; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap;}
  .wa-btn svg{width:16px; height:16px; fill:var(--white);}

  .hero{padding:44px 0 30px;}
  .hero-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.95fr; gap:44px; align-items:center;}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--sage-light); color:var(--sage); padding:6px 14px; border-radius:100px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:16px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:40px; line-height:1.1; color:var(--ink);}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal; color:var(--clay);}
  .hero p.lead{font-size:17px; color:#4B564F; margin:16px 0 24px; max-width:46ch;}
  .price-row{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:14px; margin-bottom:22px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .price-now{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:36px; font-weight:800; color:var(--clay-dark);}
  .badge-ship{display:inline-block; background:var(--gold); color:var(--ink); font-weight:800; font-size:12px; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:6px; animation:pulseBadge 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes pulseBadge{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);}50%{transform:scale(1.06);}}

  .cta-primary{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); font-weight:800; font-size:17px; padding:18px 30px; border-radius:12px; border:none; cursor:pointer; width:100%; max-width:420px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(232,93,42,0.32); text-decoration:none; animation:shakeCTA 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .cta-primary:hover{background:var(--clay-dark);}
  @keyframes shakeCTA{0%,88%,100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0);}89%{transform:translateX(-3px) rotate(-1deg);}90%{transform:translateX(3px) rotate(1deg);}91%{transform:translateX(-3px) rotate(-1deg);}92%{transform:translateX(3px) rotate(1deg);}93%{transform:translateX(-2px) rotate(0);}94%{transform:translateX(0);}}
  .cta-sub{font-size:13px; color:#6b7268; margin-top:10px;}
  .hero-media{position:relative;}
  .hero-media img{border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(31,42,36,0.18); width:100%; object-fit:cover; aspect-ratio:4/5;}
  .float-tag{position:absolute; bottom:-14px; left:-14px; background:var(--white); border-radius:12px; padding:10px 16px; box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--sage); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
  .float-tag .dot{width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--sage); animation:blink 1.6s infinite;}
  @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:.3;}}
  @media(max-width:860px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:26px;} .hero h1{font-size:29px;}}

  .shipband{background:var(--sage); color:var(--white); padding:13px 0; overflow:hidden; position:relative;}
  .shipband-track{display:flex; gap:48px; white-space:nowrap; animation:scrollBand 18s linear infinite; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .shipband-track span{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
  @keyframes scrollBand{0%{transform:translateX(0);}100%{transform:translateX(-50%);}}

  section{padding:60px 0;}
  .section-title{text-align:center; max-width:640px; margin:0 auto 36px;}
  .section-title .eyebrow{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .section-title h2{font-size:29px; color:var(--ink);}
  .section-title p{color:#5c655e; margin-top:10px; font-size:16px;}

  .feat-section{background:var(--white);}
  .feat-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:26px;}
  .feat-card{padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; background:var(--cream);}
  .feat-icon{width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--clay); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:14px; color:var(--white); font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700;}
  .feat-card h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .feat-card p{font-size:14px; color:#5c655e; margin:0;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .apps-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:center;}
  .apps-grid img{border-radius:16px; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media(max-width:800px){.apps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .kit-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px;}
  .kit-grid img{border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .includes{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:44px; align-items:center;}
  .includes-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .includes-list li{display:flex; gap:12px; padding:11px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:15px;}
  .includes-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .check{color:var(--sage); font-weight:800;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.includes{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .specs{background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:8px 24px;}
  .spec-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:15px;}
  .spec-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .spec-row b{color:var(--ink);}
  .spec-row span:last-child{color:#5c655e;}

  .trust{background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);}
  .trust .section-title h2{color:var(--cream);}
  .trust .section-title p{color:#B9C2BB;}
  .trust-img{max-width:520px; margin:0 auto; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden;}
  .badges-row{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; margin-top:32px;}
  .pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); padding:9px 16px; border-radius:100px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;}

  .note-wifi{background:var(--sage-light); border:1px solid var(--sage); color:var(--sage); border-radius:12px; padding:14px 18px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; max-width:600px; margin:0 auto 40px; text-align:center;}

  .order{background:var(--white); border-radius:24px; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:36px; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(31,42,36,0.08);}
  .order-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:40px;}
  .order h2{font-size:26px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .order p.sub{color:#5c655e; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:22px;}
  .form-row{margin-bottom:15px;}
  .form-row label{display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--ink);}
  .form-row input, .form-row select{width:100%; padding:13px 14px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif; font-size:15px; background:var(--cream);}
  .form-row input:focus, .form-row select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--clay); outline-offset:1px;}
  .addr-toggle{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .addr-opt{flex:1; text-align:center; padding:12px 8px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; background:var(--cream);}
  .addr-opt.active{background:var(--sage-light); border-color:var(--sage); color:var(--sage);}
  .qty-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:20px;}
  .qty-btn{width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--cream); font-size:18px; cursor:pointer;}
  .totalbar{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:16px 18px; background:var(--sage-light); border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .totalbar b{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:20px; color:var(--sage);}
  .order-side{background:var(--cream); border-radius:16px; padding:24px;}
  .order-side h3{font-size:16px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  .order-side ul{margin:0 0 18px; padding-left:18px; font-size:14px; color:#4B564F;}
  .order-side ul li{margin-bottom:8px;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.order{padding:24px;} .order-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:26px;}}

  .ticker-wrap{max-width:440px; margin:0 auto 40px; background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:14px 18px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);}
  .ticker-dot{width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--sage); flex-shrink:0; animation:blink 1.6s infinite;}
  #ticker-text{font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); transition:opacity .3s;}

  .faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:16px 0;}
  .faq-q{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; gap:12px;}
  .faq-a{max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .3s ease; font-size:14px; color:#5c655e;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:220px; padding-top:10px;}
  .faq-plus{font-size:20px; transition:transform .3s; flex-shrink:0;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-plus{transform:rotate(45deg);}

  footer{background:var(--ink); color:#B9C2BB; padding:36px 0; font-size:13px;}
  .foot-grid{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:18px; align-items:center;}
  .foot-logo img{height:26px; border-radius:5px;}

  .sticky-cta{position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:60; background:var(--white); border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:12px 16px; display:none; box-shadow:0 -8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}
  .sticky-cta a{display:block; text-align:center; background:var(--clay); color:var(--white); font-weight:800; padding:14px; border-radius:10px; text-decoration:none; animation:shakeCTA 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @media(max-width:700px){.sticky-cta{display:block;} body{padding-bottom:76px;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="topstrip">🚚 <b>Envío gratis</b> a toda Colombia · 💵 Pagas cuando lo recibes en tu casa</div>

<header>
  <div class="headerbar wrap">
    <div class="logo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="TROGÜI"></div>
    <a class="wa-btn" href="https://wa.me/573206572598" target="_blank">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17.5 14.4c-.3-.1-1.7-.8-2-1-.3-.1-.5-.1-.6.1-.2.3-.7 1-.9 1.2-.2.2-.3.2-.6.1-.3-.1-1.2-.4-2.3-1.4-.9-.8-1.4-1.7-1.6-2-.2-.3 0-.5.1-.6.1-.1.3-.3.4-.5.1-.1.2-.3.2-.4.1-.2 0-.3 0-.4-.1-.1-.6-1.5-.8-2-.2-.5-.4-.5-.6-.5h-.5c-.2 0-.5.1-.7.3-.2.3-.9 1-.9 2.3 0 1.3 1 2.6 1.1 2.8.1.2 2 3 4.8 4.3.7.3 1.2.5 1.6.6.7.2 1.3.2 1.8.1.5-.1 1.7-.7 1.9-1.4.2-.7.2-1.2.2-1.3-.1-.1-.3-.2-.6-.3z"/><path d="M12 2C6.5 2 2 6.5 2 12c0 1.8.5 3.6 1.4 5.1L2 22l5-1.3c1.5.8 3.2 1.3 4.9 1.3 5.5 0 10-4.5 10-10S17.5 2 12 2zm0 18.3c-1.6 0-3.1-.4-4.5-1.2l-.3-.2-3 .8.8-2.9-.2-.3C4 15 3.6 13.5 3.6 12 3.6 7.4 7.4 3.6 12 3.6c4.6 0 8.4 3.8 8.4 8.4 0 4.6-3.8 8.3-8.4 8.3z"/></svg>
      WhatsApp
    </a>
  </div>
</header>

      <div class="float-tag"><span class="dot"></span> Se configura en minutos</div>

</section>

<div class="shipband">
  <div class="shipband-track">
    <span>🚚 Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span>
    <span>💵 Pago contra entrega</span>
    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
    <span>🚚 Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span>
    <span>💵 Pago contra entrega</span>
    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
    <span>🚚 Envío gratis a toda Colombia</span>
    <span>💵 Pago contra entrega</span>
    <span>✅ Producto nuevo y garantizado</span>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="feat-section">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow">Por qué te sirve</span>
      <h2>Todo lo que necesitas para modernizar tu TV</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="feat-grid">
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">4K</div><h3>Ultra HD real</h3><p>Imagen nítida y colores realistas, muy por encima de HD y Full HD.</p></div>
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">📶</div><h3>Se conecta por WiFi</h3><p>Solo necesitas internet en casa. Se configura en pocos minutos.</p></div>
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">📲</div><h3>Espejo de tu celular</h3><p>Con AIRSCREEN puedes pasar fotos, videos y música de tu teléfono a la pantalla grande.</p></div>
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">🎮</div><h3>Control remoto incluido</h3><p>Maneja todo desde el sofá: apps, volumen, navegación, sin complicaciones.</p></div>
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">💾</div><h3>2GB RAM · 16GB</h3><p>Memoria suficiente para tener varias apps instaladas sin que se ponga lento.</p></div>
      <div class="feat-card"><div class="feat-icon">🔌</div><h3>Fácil de instalar</h3><p>Se conecta al puerto HDMI de tu TV. Incluye extensión HDMI y cable USB-C.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow">Tus plataformas, en tu TV</span>
      <h2>Accede a tus aplicaciones favoritas</h2>

    </div>
    <div class="note-wifi" style="margin-top:28px;">📶 Recuerda: para ver canales, películas y series necesitas conexión a internet (WiFi) en tu casa.</div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="feat-section">
  <div class="wrap includes">
    <div class="kit-grid">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Contenido de la caja TV Stick TROGÜI">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="TV Stick, control y cables TROGÜI">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Diagrama de contenido: control remoto, stick, extensión HDMI, cable USB, receptor infrarrojo">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="TV Stick conectado a un televisor grande">
    </div>
    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">Qué incluye tu pedido</span>
      <h2 style="font-size:27px; margin-bottom:20px;">Todo listo para conectar y usar</h2>

<section>
  <div class="wrap" style="max-width:700px;">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow">Ficha técnica</span>
      <h2>Especificaciones</h2>

      <div class="spec-row"><b>Audio</b><span>Estéreo</span></div>
      <div class="spec-row"><b>Memoria RAM</b><span>2 GB</span></div>
      <div class="spec-row"><b>Almacenamiento</b><span>16 GB</span></div>
      <div class="spec-row"><b>Sistema</b><span>Android TV</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow">Estilo de vida</span>
      <h2>Cine en casa, cuando quieras</h2>
    </div>
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Familia disfrutando del TV Stick TROGÜI" style="border-radius:18px; max-width:640px; margin:0 auto; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(31,42,36,0.15);">
  </div>
</section>

<section class="trust">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color:var(--gold);">Envíos confiables</span>

    </div>

    <div class="badges-row">
      <span class="pill">✅ Producto nuevo</span>

<section id="pedido">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="ticker-wrap">
      <span class="ticker-dot"></span>
      <span id="ticker-text">Cargando actividad reciente...</span>
    </div>

    <div class="order">
      <div class="order-grid">
        <div>
          <h2>Completa tu pedido</h2>
          <p class="sub">Diligencia tus datos. Un asesor confirma por WhatsApp antes de despachar.</p>

          <form id="orderForm" onsubmit="return false;">
            <div class="form-row"><label>Nombre completo</label><input type="text" placeholder="Ej: Laura Gómez" required></div>
            <div class="form-row"><label>Teléfono / WhatsApp</label><input type="tel" placeholder="Ej: 300 123 4567" required></div>
            <div class="form-row">
              <label>Departamento</label>
              <select required>
                <option value="">Selecciona tu departamento</option>
                <option>Antioquia</option><option>Atlántico</option><option>Bogotá D.C.</option>
                <option>Bolívar</option><option>Boyacá</option><option>Caldas</option>
                <option>Cauca</option><option>Cesar</option><option>Chocó</option>
                <option>Córdoba</option><option>Cundinamarca</option><option>Huila</option>
                <option>La Guajira</option><option>Magdalena</option><option>Meta</option>
                <option>Nariño</option><option>Norte de Santander</option><option>Quindío</option>
                <option>Risaralda</option><option>Santander</option><option>Sucre</option>

                <button type="button" class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(-1)">−</button>
                <span id="qtyDisplay" style="font-weight:700; font-size:16px;">1 unidad</span>
                <button type="button" class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(1)">+</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="totalbar"><span>Total a pagar contra entrega</span><b id="totalPrice">$89.000</b></div>
            <a href="https://wa.me/573206572598" target="_blank" class="cta-primary" style="text-decoration:none;">✅ Confirmar pedido — Pago contra entrega</a>
            <p class="cta-sub" style="text-align:center;">Al confirmar, un asesor te escribe por WhatsApp para verificar tu dirección.</p>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div class="order-side">
          <h3>Por qué comprar en TROGÜI</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Envío gratis a toda Colombia</li>
            <li>Pagas solo cuando el producto está en tus manos</li>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap" style="max-width:760px;">
    <div class="section-title">
      <span class="eyebrow">Preguntas frecuentes</span>
      <h2>Todo lo que quieres saber antes de pedir</h2>
    </div>
    <div id="faqList">
      <div class="faq-item">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)"><span>¿Sirve en cualquier televisor?</span><span class="faq-plus">+</span></div>
        <div class="faq-a">Sí, funciona en cualquier TV que tenga entrada HDMI, sea o no Smart TV. Solo necesitas conexión WiFi en casa.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)"><span>¿Necesito pagar algo aparte para usarlo?</span><span class="faq-plus">+</span></div>
        <div class="faq-a">El dispositivo te da acceso a la tienda de aplicaciones para instalar tus apps de streaming (Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, etc.). Las suscripciones de pago de cada plataforma corren por tu cuenta, igual que en cualquier Smart TV.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)"><span>¿De verdad pago solo cuando lo recibo?</span><span class="faq-plus">+</span></div>
        <div class="faq-a">Sí. No pagas nada por adelantado. Pagas en efectivo al mensajero cuando el producto llega a tu dirección.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)"><span>¿Cuánto tarda el envío?</span><span class="faq-plus">+</span></div>
        <div class="faq-a">Entre 2 y 5 días hábiles dependiendo de tu ciudad, a través de Interrapidísimo o Coordinadora.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item">
        <div class="faq-q" onclick="toggleFaq(this)"><span>¿Es difícil de instalar?</span><span class="faq-plus">+</span></div>
        <div class="faq-a">No. Se conecta al puerto HDMI de tu TV, lo conectas a la corriente con el cable USB incluido, seleccionas tu red WiFi, y en minutos queda listo para usar.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap foot-grid">
    <div class="foot-logo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="TROGÜI"></div>

  </div>
</footer>

<div class="sticky-cta"><a href="#pedido">Pedir ahora — $89.000</a></div>

<script>
  function setDelivery(type){
    document.getElementById('opt-domicilio').classList.toggle('active', type==='domicilio');
    document.getElementById('opt-oficina').classList.toggle('active', type==='oficina');
  }
  let qty = 1; const unitPrice = 89000;
  function changeQty(delta){
    qty = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, qty + delta));
    document.getElementById('qtyDisplay').textContent = qty + (qty===1 ? ' unidad' : ' unidades');
    document.getElementById('totalPrice').textContent = '$' + (qty*unitPrice).toLocaleString('es-CO');
  }
  function toggleFaq(el){ el.parentElement.classList.toggle('open'); }

  const tickerMessages = [
    "🚚 Hoy estamos despachando pedidos a Bogotá, Cali y Medellín",
    "✅ Cientos de TV Stick entregados en toda Colombia",
    "📦 Envío gratis activo en todo el país",
    "💵 Recuerda: pagas solo cuando recibes tu pedido"
  ];
  let tIndex = 0;
  const tickerEl = document.getElementById('ticker-text');
  function rotateTicker(){
    tickerEl.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(()=>{ tIndex = (tIndex+1) % tickerMessages.length; tickerEl.textContent = tickerMessages[tIndex]; tickerEl.style.opacity = 1; }, 300);
  }
  tickerEl.textContent = tickerMessages[0];
  setInterval(rotateTicker, 5000);
</script>

</body>
</html>
